kind,cpus,timeout=sys.argv[1:];name='source-bank-'+kind
command=['systemd-run','--user','--unit='+name,'--service-type=exec','--slice=background.slice','--working-directory='+source,'--property=KillMode=control-group','--property=RuntimeMaxSec='+timeout,'--property=TimeoutStopSec=30','--property=Nice=10','--property=CPUAffinity='+cpus.replace('-', ' - '),'--property=MemoryMax=256G','/usr/bin/taskset','-c',cpus,'/usr/bin/python3',source+'/scripts/job.py','--output-dir',str(root/'artifacts/jobs'/name),'--','/bin/bash',str(base/(kind+'.sh'))]

measurements.contention: No builds overlapped timing; resident-resource correctness used other CPU pools/devices. External host/device contention not traced. No exclusivity or peak claim.
measurements.prior_differences: Prior source1f CPU affinity12-15; NPU physical5 with affinity24-27. Current CPU0-7; NPU physical1 with affinity32-35. Torch thread counts match.

scope.path: Aggregate output -> KV prepare -> Read/Describe -> regional allocation -> Full -> messages and continuation
scope.identity_check: python scripts/check_upstream.py: fixed core-5 19 snapshots and legacy 5 snapshots passed; this is provenance validation, not runtime qualification
scope.source_access: git show of the immutable source above; current worktree edits and active job inputs were left untouched
scope.bounded_deferred_item: Aggregate budget-prefix layout reconstruction remains separately recorded; this review does not reopen that completed increment.

plan.warning: G=8, Q=16 and K=16 are not guaranteed actual per-call shapes. Positive writes, history, selected queries, presence/capability partitions and workspace budgets change these dimensions.

notation.G: compatible node count in one local group, at most 8 in this region-by-region LH176 path
notation.N_g: actual received rows for node g, across all samples
notation.W_g: positive-mass write rows for node g; Wmax=max_g W_g
notation.H_g: raw bank rows for node g across all samples, including retained left state
notation.Q: maximum queried positions per sample within a packed local group
notation.K: maximum bank positions per sample within that group
notation.T_n: actual region rows having n present candidates; n is at most 8
notation.Qsel: packed selected Full queries per sample
notation.all_times_counts_offsets_slots: int64 metadata, never substituted by floating point or event-receive count

stages.input_output: The already integrated unique-source/incidence Aggregate yields each node rows[N_g], mass[N_g], content[N_g,64]. Current orchestration loops over 22 regions and hands node columns to subsequent stages.
stages.actual_granularity: Local Read and Full numeric formulas are batched over G,B,Q/K. This is not token-by-token PDG decode. The direct anchor also loops over the same region stages.
stages.mathematical_work: Preserve physical edge multiplicity, stable node/source identity, message presence and the weighted Aggregate result.
stages.interface_cost: A per-node received-column interface is retained after the source-bank increment. A typed current owner can adopt this boundary once without reopening source-bank computation.
stages.autograd: Already integrated Aggregate uses its own incidence VJP and original source roots. This review makes no new claim about its timing or qualification.

stages.numeric_formula: n=norm(u); [key,value]=base*n+adapter_u*(adapter_v*n); summary=summary_matrix*n; weight=min(mass,1), only for positive writes. Four grouped linear maps; genuine parameter aliases remain 2-D.
stages.packing_publication: Mapped roles pack positive rows. Generic tensor boundary publishes keys, values, summaries and weights separately per node by index_select: 4G field publications.
stages.autograd: Packing and node-field publication occur inside the custom Function no-grad boundary. A private numeric graph supplies its declared first-order VJP; the copies still execute.
stages.mathematical_work: Positive-write selection, shared parameters and private per-node/per-sample state are required. Splitting all four outputs into per-node tensors is an interface choice.
stages.direct_anchor: Projects dense region tensors [N,B,L,...] and masks invalid writes; this may perform more numeric writes than the public positive-only path.

stages.stage: window bank and terminal raw state assembly

shapes.layout: sample offsets and raw logical timestamps, int64

stages.packing_publication: For each node and four fields, cat(old,fresh) then index_select(permutation). With a finite window, each field is gathered again into terminal retention, even when the retained rows happen to be unchanged.
stages.conditional_expression_count: For one G=8 group with actual writes: 32 field cat+select pairs, plus 32 terminal trim selections when window>0. This counts source expressions, not kernels or timings.
stages.autograd: Unlike tensor-kernel publication, these bank cat/index_select calls are outside that custom Function and contribute ordinary autograd operations/edges.
stages.mathematical_work: The full window bank must retain earlier-query-visible entries. Terminal expiry applies only to a sample that received a positive write. An all-zero receive must preserve old expired raw entries, clock/count and inert fields exactly.
stages.interface_cost: Per-node bank reassembly and immediate terminal materialization are not required by the mathematics. An owner may retain a common raw bank plus explicit int64 snapshot/retention maps.
stages.direct_anchor: Keeps one region bank [N,B,K,...], appends each float field along time, stores validity and only removes columns that are padding for every node/sample.

stages.packing_publication: Read constructs node/sample query and bank layout again. sum uses u,mass,weights,summaries roles; qry uses u,mass,weights,keys,values. Each mapped role cat+sentinel+gather packs original per-node roots. Result fields are gathered back into each node: ind has four fields and att six (32 or 48 publications for G=8).
implementation_differences: Python constructs age/visibility on CPU and transfers it; C++ derives them from device timestamps.

Python active-presence classification first packs weights and the later kernel packs them again; mixed active/inactive groups rebuild layouts. C++ classifies directly from raw bank/visibility and batches flags back to host, without this same duplicate weights pack.

Python Read normalizes u and Describe normalizes it again; C++ reuses the current normalized result once. Direct also normalizes at distinct write/read/full stages, so not every normalization is an interface-only cost.
stages.autograd: Mapped-role packing and per-node publication are under a custom Function no-grad boundary; formula operations live in the private graph. Private graph dependencies are scanned per returned field. VJP packs node bars by field via cat+index_copy, performs nested autograd.grad, then applies each role transpose.
stages.mathematical_work: Read snapshot, original logical ages, sum/query memories, complete local score/evidence/key returns and independent-root/None-zero support must survive. Read qry reuses one QK for short and long variants.
stages.non_reuse: Read uses summary-width 32 K/V projections; Full uses raw width 64 K/V. Their projected values cannot be presumed identical reusable buffers.
stages.direct_anchor: Passes the region bank directly to batched formula and keeps Descriptor tensors as blocks.

shapes.packed_fields: [T_n,n,*field], grouping by actual candidate count n<=8
shapes.control: same actual region-row/candidate incidence, then returned as per-node columns

stages.packing_publication: Aligned fields stack per-node columns; ragged fields cat+gather+reshape. Different candidate memberships can share a candidate-count group. Controls return by unbind or custom inverse gather; Full then extracts positive-control rows per node.
stages.autograd: Aligned/same-membership paths can have ordinary autograd stack/unbind. Varying-membership training uses the grouped regional custom VJP with private graphs, finite structural dependency branches and field/node inverse mapping. Backward support classification includes host row scans.
stages.mathematical_work: All actual candidates of a region must compete together, with stable IDs/ties, score/evidence, allocation constraints, declared solve/hard-function VJP, and exact structural support. This is a cross-node coupled stage.
stages.interface_cost: Node Descriptor -> regional field assembly -> node controls -> selected-Full packing is not forced by core-5. A RegionCandidatePlan can map a DescriptorBlock directly, with a necessary gather only for genuinely ragged incidence.
stages.direct_anchor: Mostly view/movedim into region formulas. Its quad solve is independently implemented and has a narrower domain; it is not a substitute for every public send/score/regularizer or root contract.

stages.packing_publication: Full reconstructs u/weights/keys/values roles and layouts after control publication. It performs batched attention and FFN, then gathers one content field per active node; a later message column combines control and content while retaining support.
stages.autograd: Separate private Full graph with original bank/input/parameter roots. Field cotangents are repacked for VJP. True shared parameter gradients include every user and attach to only one actual alias edge, avoiding multiplication by G.
stages.mathematical_work: Only actual selected queries undergo Full in the public contract; messages retain separate (c,G) and presence, not an already multiplied cG masquerading as payload. Full reads the updated <=t bank snapshot.
stages.interface_cost: A selected QueryPlan can borrow the prepared owner bank and return a MessageBlock without reintroducing per-node float fields.
stages.direct_anchor: Computes dense Full for N*B*L then masks. That different work shape is useful as a formula/performance anchor but cannot silently replace selected-query semantics or independent-root support.

stages.current_state: Same-device/same-dtype transfer returns the original Tensor. Per-call/per-dtype regional parameter views and identity deduplication of actual selection operands are already fixed at this source.
stages.remaining_cost: Per-node descriptor/field interfaces still determine collection and publication around a true device boundary. Do not attribute this to already-fixed duplicate regional parameter conversions.
stages.mathematical_work: Only real requested device/dtype changes require numerical transport. Mixed presets do not mandate a fixed number of software layers.
stages.autograd: Cross-device version, alias identity, asynchronous lifetime and reverse transfer remain part of the declared VJP. A block transport boundary must preserve all of these; same-device paths should keep owners intact.

stages.current_state: Default window execution immediately exports per-node columns into Continuation, decoding B raw states per node and updating history/ledger by actual rows. A following import cats the B states back into each of four node fields.
stages.mathematical_work: A checkpoint must encode exact raw state, metadata, continuation/history/ledger and pending semantics. A visible-state projection alone is insufficient.
stages.interface_cost: Immediate record materialization on every window is not required when the next consumer can retain a typed owner. This contributes default-versus-public cost, not public-versus-direct cost.
stages.direct_anchor: Maintains region banks between calls and materializes per-node/sample states only for an explicit observation/decoder.
stages.proposal: A versioned typed continuation retains owner raw banks and int64 layouts; serialization or explicitly requested compatibility/observation uses the codec. New-process exact recovery remains an independent gate.

loop_and_scaling_conclusion.numeric: Core Read/Full arithmetic already uses G*B*Q/K tensors. There is no per-token numerical dispatch at this reviewed boundary.
loop_and_scaling_conclusion.calls: Per-node field publication and several checks scale with G, fields and compatibility/presence/budget groups, not with one call per B*L event. Region iteration is shared by direct and public algorithms.
loop_and_scaling_conclusion.host_work: Metadata layout and branch-support scans still traverse actual node-row and bank-row entries; their work grows with B*L/K.
loop_and_scaling_conclusion.device_work: Tensor elements and attention arithmetic grow with G*B*Q*K. Memory budget or actual dependency partitions may add groups; fixed call count cannot be promised for arbitrary B,L.
loop_and_scaling_conclusion.regional_grouping: Candidate-count groups (at most eight here) aggregate many row memberships. They are not one group per token or per distinct candidate subset.

next_rewrite_boundary.name: typed KV region-window owner with real stage causality
next_rewrite_boundary.not_just: A larger wrapper around the existing node-independent tensor_kernel, or a single opaque Function returning causally related state and outputs as independent siblings.
next_rewrite_boundary.scope: Begin with the existing compatible host FP32/FP64 KV group; cover prepare, raw bank, Read/Describe, regional allocation, selected Full, messages and typed continuation. Preserve the generic fallback and independent Python/C++ schedules.

components.owns: current u/mass, original roots/alias identity, initial bank, full window bank, terminal retention maps, raw four fields, int64 node/sample/position/slot layouts, actual presence and positive-write maps, dtype/device/schema/parameter role versions
batched Read/score/evidence/key fields and actual stage-root relationships; no per-node float publication as the internal default
complete actual region-row/candidate incidence over one or several compatible memory blocks, stable candidate IDs and logical row mapping; aligned view/movedim or a single required ragged gather
regional controls plus explicit support; selected Full queries borrowing the same correct snapshot bank
separate sending strength c, content G, physical incidence and support for the next Aggregate
raw state, layout and metadata retained between windows; decode/encode only at actual serialization or requested observation boundary

implementation_order: Adopt the existing Aggregate received columns once into current typed storage.
Keep grouped write results in the owner rather than publishing four per-node fields and rebuilding raw banks.
Borrow that bank for Read, carry Descriptor blocks through a complete-region plan, preserve control blocks into selected Full.
Return Message blocks and retain terminal raw state as a layout over owned storage.
Add necessary actual device transports and explicit observable/codec adapters; version public contract if required.
keep_first: existing regional allocation/solver identities and first-order VJPs
next_rewrite_boundary.module_extensibility: Use typed bank/schema variants for KV and fixed-shape recurrent memories. A single universal giant tensor is unnecessary; region incidence composes descriptors from heterogeneous block owners.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: The current tensor_kernel connected[role][g] rule assumes output node g depends on node-local role g except actual shared parameters. Regional allocation couples nodes. Reusing this rule for the entire region pipeline would lose valid cross-node dependencies.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Independent roots on two competing nodes and true shared parameters, including a loss on only one selected output.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: Returning prepared raw fields and a final output as independent sibling outputs of one opaque Function does not preserve grad(final, raw_field). A lazy slice created only after execution likewise is not necessarily an actual consumed root.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Declare block roots plus typed VJP observation references, or preinstall requested stage-root taps that downstream computations actually consume. Check independent intermediate raw/Read/control/message roots and None versus connected zero. O(G*fields) root metadata is acceptable; do not reintroduce B*L float gather/cat.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: Presence, candidate support, query memory availability, allocation branches and zero values are distinct. Preserve exact branch/root support rather than inferring it from padded numerical zeros.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Missing/zero messages, all-zero weights, independent equal-valued roots, regional cap/KKT/empty branches and disconnected gradients.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: Read0 binds initial state; Read- uses strict tprime<t; Read+ uses <=t. Full uses updated <=t state. Window-history and terminal-retained banks differ.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Nonempty left bank, all Read modes, early queries whose history would be terminal-expired, and nonaligned original int64 logical times.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: Expiry occurs only on positive writes for that sample. All-zero receives retain expired raw rows. Inert/count/last-times/history/ledger cannot be dropped as numerically invisible.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Zero-write windows, finite window expiry, multi-sample unequal lengths, serialized new-process recovery and exact next-window state.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: True aliasing, coincident values and private state are different. Write/Read summary role sharing must accumulate every contribution once without multiplying a shared already-summed gradient.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Shared and equal-but-independent parameters, two consumers, private histories, independent loss roots and optimizer updates.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: Different KV capability groups may contribute to the same region. Never allocate each group separately; one complete candidate set must be preserved.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Heterogeneous memory/read modes in one region and ragged candidate membership with stable ties.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: Do not replace actual selected Full by dense Full plus mask without an explicit semantic/root contract. Sending strength c and content G remain distinct; no duplicate multiplication.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Selected versus unselected dependencies, fractional regional_total_zero support, duplicate edges, full message payload and aggregate projection.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: The direct anchor has convenient common logical times. A shared Q*K time mask is legal only when actual node/sample logical domains agree.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Sparse and nonaligned timestamps, differing histories and sample offsets, general Settle ports and fallback PDG/TimedDAG windows.

correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.detail: Block transport must retain versions, alias identity, dependency edges and asynchronous owner lifetime. Software mixed presets do not impose additional boundaries.
correctness_risks_and_required_witnesses.witness: Same-device no-copy identity, actual cross-device VJP, owner release and explicit requested/effective placement, separately qualified from numerical local tests.

direct_anchor_domain.supported: Same KV configuration within a region, Read+, cat local/evidence, regional_total, quad, strict support, ind or att region scoring with content_stats key.
direct_anchor_domain.not_certified: General PDG, every configurable local candidate, exact public intermediate-root/None support or all raw-state edge cases are not inferred from this direct formula.
direct_anchor_domain.interpretation: Dense invalid-write projection and dense Full plus mask can perform extra work; different quad implementation and narrower roots matter. Direct/public time differences are not automatically pure redundant work or an absolute speed limit.

caveats: Static source expression counts are not ATen profiler counts, device kernel counts, latency or proof of a measured bottleneck.
This record adds no benchmark, hardware, CUDA/NPU qualification or new runtime test result.
Source hashes identify exactly the reviewed implementation. Current HEAD may be newer; no unrecorded adoption of later files is implied.
Grouping, actual selected Full count, source reuse and history length must accompany any later same-material timing.
The proposed owner rewrite is a next implementation boundary, not a completed feature or a proof that every interface copy can disappear.

static_review.scope: Read-only source/dataflow review; no new profile. Loop sizes and expression counts are not measured hardware kernel counts or per-stage wall-time attribution.
